digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding store and dispatch
propositions: DC Lucene index eventual consistency causes JQL searches to miss recently-created issues, leading recover_pending to incorrectly unbind keyless-pending entries and dispatch_one.create_one to issue duplicate creates for the same local ticket

The duplicate is written at the create gate (dispatch_one.create_one dedup search), not at the unbind site; fixing only recover_pending's unbind logic is insufficient because get_jira_key returns None for keyless-pending entries and the create gate does not consult is_pending

Recovery must record negative search attempts on keyless-pending entries and defer unbinding until search_miss_count >= 3 AND entry age exceeds a grace window (3600s); the create gate must then defer (not drop) creates while a keyless-pending binding for that local_id is younger than the grace window

The deferred-create guard must live in dispatch_one.create_one (not outbound_differ.py) to preserve existing deferred-create semantics and respect the module's 800-LOC cap, and recover_pending must not count still-pending entries as resolved

Both Jira Cloud and DC follow the same path because eventual consistency affects both vendors; a vendor branch would exercise only the slow path and leave the correctness property (never conclude non-existence from one search) unexercised on Cloud

Held-out regression test must drive the full crash -> recover -> differ -> create path under a lagging-index client (create succeeds, search returns empty) and assert exactly ONE issue is created, which would fail against current code
